name: Diana
context: Advisor said 'safe dividends' and built what looks like a conservative portfolio. The reality: 19% of her retirement is in Royal Bank alone — RY appears as a direct $30K holding plus hidden inside ZEB (16.7%), ZDV (6.5%), and XIC (6.8%). Total true RY exposure: ~$42K. A single BOC rate decision hits ZAG (bonds), ZEB (banks), ZDV (dividend stocks), and ENB (pipeline rate play) — 64% of her $220K retirement exposed to one signal. She's 7 years from retirement and doesn't know any of this. Her advisor never decomposed the overlap.
